blind.description: A straight subterranean wall segment designed in a stylized hand-painted fantasy art style. The lower portion consists of rough, carved bedrock or stone blocks with earthy brown and mossy-green coloration, while the upper section consists of dark brown horizontal wooden planks supported by a thick central vertical timber post and capped with a heavy horizontal wooden beam. Surfaces are completely solid, manifold, and continuous, with no disconnected floating pieces, shards, or holes. Underside rests flat on the floor without any added base plate or plinth. Textures are fully painted with no untextured or raw black areas, and there is no illumination or fire effect.
blind.from_above: A simple narrow dark-brown wooden rectangle forming the top cap of the wall segment.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.5 times as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 9 feet tall), and about 4 to 5 feet wide (spanning roughly one 5-ft grid unit).
